sql.query: INSERT INTO tb_survey_paper (paper_id, paper_title, qstn_cnt, qstn_add_seq, reg_dt) select ? paper_id, ('복사 - '+paper_title) paper_title, qstn_cnt, qstn_add_seq, getdate() from tb_survey_paper where paper_id = ?

INSERT INTO tb_survey_qstn ( qstn_no, paper_id, qstn_answ, answ_type, answ_cnt, exmp_add_seq, multi_yn, multi_cnt, connect_yn, qstn_ord ) select REPLACE(qstn_no, ?, ? ) AS qstn_no, ? as paper_id, qstn_answ, answ_type, answ_cnt, exmp_add_seq, multi_yn, multi_cnt, connect_yn, qstn_ord from tb_survey_qstn where paper_id = ?

INSERT INTO tb_survey_qstn_exmp (exmp_seq_no, exmp_sort_no, qstn_no, exmp_word, connect_qstn_no) select REPLACE(exmp_seq_no, ?, ?) as exmp_seq_no, exmp_sort_no, REPLACE(qstn_no, ?, ?) as qstn_no, exmp_word, REPLACE(connect_qstn_no, ?, ?) as connect_qstn_no from tb_survey_qstn_exmp where qstn_no like ( ? + '_' + '%')
